hypotheses.F0_analytic_factor_chain_is_exact: Every analytic factor chain reconstructs the autograd Jacobian with energy fidelity at least 0.9999.
hypotheses.F1_rules_have_more_reusable_mean_factors: For both seeds, the pure-rule Layer-0 all-mean factor chain exceeds the mixed model by at least 0.30 fidelity.
hypotheses.F2_mixed_block_factors_are_more_diverse: For both seeds, at least two of downstream block factors A1, A2, and A3 have at least twice the pure model's effective rank in the mixed model.
hypotheses.F3_final_readout_factor_is_reusable: For every seed and regime, replacing only the final readout factor O by its discovery mean retains at least 0.90 Layer-0 Jacobian fidelity.
hypotheses.F4_mixed_diversity_has_a_causal_factor_l: For every mixed model, freezing at least one individual downstream factor to its mean loses at least 0.05 Layer-0 fidelity.
hypotheses.F5_no_single_mixed_factor_explains_the_c: For every mixed model, no one site-specific downstream factor with all others mean reaches 0.80 Layer-0 Jacobian fidelity.
